people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.
translations.bsb: For Jesus has been counted worthy of greater glory than Moses, just as the builder of a house has greater honor than the house itself.
translations.kjv: For this man was counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who hath builded the house hath more honour than the house.
translations.asv: For he hath been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, by so much as he that built the house hath more honor than the house.
